hypothesis: A TRAIN-conditioned causal rule proposal program that uses public intervention-outcome evidence to rank conditional unknown transition-rule hypotheses, then updates an exact persistent graph/mode/law posterior, can reduce complete causal inference work on unfamiliar nonlinear future rules over the strongest equally informed exact and learned controls while never making an unsound certification.

new_mechanism.actual_learned_path: Fit public TRAIN-derived conditional frequencies of truth-table output bits indexed by family and parent input. For each DEV public causal sequence, these fitted coefficients must change the order of exact graph/mode/law proposals, used in the executed future-output algorithm—not merely validate a permutation. Audit trained-vs-ablated hypothesis visitation and parameter influence on held-out, non-source mathematical fixtures BEFORE DEV.
new_mechanism.exactness: Each proposal must satisfy every revealed public constraint. Early UNKNOWN only on demonstrated output disagreement; to CERTIFY output exhaust all public-consistent graph/mode/law hypotheses, or use complete exact fallback. Learned probability is never an answer certificate. No posterior hypothesis may be discarded by learned score.
new_mechanism.online_update: Each newly revealed public causal observation refines known/ones truth-table constraints per candidate graph/mode, retaining a reusable exact posterior without consulting the hidden graph, law or private future targets.

pure exact full enumeration independently validating the constraint solver
new_mechanism.learning_eligibility: If disabling fitted coefficients does not measurably alter inference work/order on TRAIN/source-free fixtures, STOP before DEV and label LEARNED_PARAMETER_DISCONNECTED; no unseen-source run.
new_mechanism.controls_independence: Disclose shared truth-table transition kernel; prove an actually separate exhaustive enumerator implementation vs exact bit-constraint solver; do not rename one algorithm as multiple controls.
